consultant.name: Daniel Deepak
consultant.line: Before I spend a rupee, I find where the last one leaked.

leaks.name: Miscounted conversions
leaks.one: The ad platform reports sales the till never saw. Bidding chases fiction.
leaks.signal: Platform conversions above real orders. Value per conversion far from average order.
leaks.fix: Read conversion actions, not goal cards. Reconcile to the till weekly. Stop rule at 60%.

leaks.name: Money on the wrong intent
leaks.one: Budget sits where it is easy to spend, not where buyers convert.
leaks.signal: Share of spend and share of results don't match. One ad group starves the rest.
leaks.fix: Rank spend by revenue per rupee at the unit that bills. Cap, kill or fund.

leaks.name: Post-click friction
leaks.one: The ad works. The page, form or checkout after it doesn't.
leaks.signal: Healthy CTR, poor conversion. Results move while spend and CPC stay flat.
leaks.fix: Book it yourself on a phone. Cut steps, fix speed, price and phone above the fold.

leaks.name: Invisible where buyers look
leaks.one: Missing from the map pack, directories, page one, even brand search.
leaks.signal: Competitors with fewer reviews rank above you. Your own name shows someone else.
leaks.fix: Profile, listings, service and location pages. Defend the brand term.

leaks.name: Price and channel leakage
leaks.one: Your own stock sold cheaper elsewhere, with commission on top.
leaks.signal: Google Hotels or marketplaces list third parties below your direct price.
leaks.fix: One rate card, one owner, weekly parity check, best-rate-direct promise.

leaks.name: Lead-to-booking gap
leaks.one: Leads arrive at record volume. Nobody converts them fast enough.
leaks.signal: Leads up, bookings flat or down. Calls fall while direction requests rise.
leaks.fix: Every lead to the right person's WhatsApp in five minutes. Mystery-shop peak hours.

leaks.name: Post-sale leakage
leaks.one: The sale happens. The money doesn't stay or doesn't come back.
leaks.signal: High returns, falling ticket size, one-time buyers.
leaks.fix: Returns report by SKU and checkout. Ticket-size work on the floor. Lifecycle triggers.

leaks.name: Not a marketing problem
leaks.one: Sometimes the biggest number isn't mine to fix. Saying so early saves months.
leaks.signal: The same complaint in reviews. A gap no ad change moves.
leaks.fix: Name the owner: ops, product, pricing or the shop floor. Put a rupee value on it.

cases.name: TONI&GUY Bangalore
cases.period: Data Jan 2025 – Aug 2026 · my work from Mar 2026
cases.role: Growth consultant: Google, Meta, web, booking app, reporting
cases.gradeNote: Ad exports joined to point-of-sale revenue by salon
cases.leak: Leads hit record volume; ticket size fell and no callback loop existed
cases.kpiText: salon revenue vs same months of 2025
cases.bigLabel: salon revenue on last year from March, when I joined (₹14.04 → ₹16.10 Cr). Jan–Feb ran +1.3%.

profile.business_model: Multi-location premium hair salon network in Bangalore: 16 salons on the point-of-sale sheet (Aug 2026), with Lavelle Road and Koramangala 8th Block also carrying ad spend
profile.target_customer: Walk-in and local salon customers in Bangalore; Aug 2026 impressions skewed 69.83% male and 13.65% aged 55+ per Google Ads
profile.geography: Bangalore, India (malls, Nexus, Phoenix, Koramangala, Whitefield, JP Nagar, Hennur and others)
profile.commercial_objective: Salon revenue against monthly store targets (Aug 2026 network target Rs 2.96 Cr, 99.5% attained)
profile.revenue_mechanism: Point-of-sale bills: services, packages (28.1% of Aug sales) and product (5.4%); average bill Rs 2,813 in Aug 2026
acquisition_routes: Google Ads Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen (store and network campaigns)
Meta lead-form, click-to-WhatsApp and click-to-call campaigns per salon (from May 2026)
Instagram post boosts (132 built, 73 delivered in Aug)
Google Business Profile actions (directions, calls)
Booking website toniandguyhairdressing.com
profile.conversion_mechanism: Google conversions (calls, directions, store visits, web) and Meta leads/WhatsApp chats are followed up by salons; booking and billing happen at the salon. No lead-to-chair link exists in the data.

story60.problem: Sales growth had stalled at +1.3% on last year in Jan-Feb 2026 because average bill fell 13.5%, while Google ran an inherited, unstructured account.
story60.leak: Leads rose but each returned less: revenue per Google lead fell from Rs 3,116 to Rs 1,361, and ad money drifted to low-return salons.
story60.discovered: Joined 20 months of till data to Google exports, then in August joined ad spend to point-of-sale revenue salon by salon.
story60.did: Rebuilt Google per salon, launched per-salon Meta, moved the site to Netlify, built a booking app, reported monthly with salon P&L.
story60.changed: Mar-Aug 2026 revenue +14.7% (Rs 14.04 to 16.10 Cr), bills +21.6%, on Google spend +74%. Part is seasonal or new-salon capacity.
story60.evidence: 20-month point-of-sale and Google Ads ledger (Jan 2025 to Aug 2026) plus the August salon P&L, from the monthly reports.
story60.lesson: Spend, clicks and leads rose faster than bills. Judge ad money by bills and salon-level return, and test lead counts for definition changes.

bridge.node: Google Ads spend, Mar-Aug 2026 (Google only, excludes Meta)
Google conversions (calls, directions, store visits, web)

bridge.value: 60,027 (+21.6%). Monthly r = 0.83 between MQLs and bills over 20 months; CORRELATION only
Rs 16.10 Cr (+Rs 2.06 Cr vs 2025); incremental Rs 2.06 Cr / Rs 10.81 L extra Google spend = 19.1x, not causal (new salons, season, Meta also moved)

profile.industry: Premium imitation jewellery (kadas, earrings, men's brooches, festive sets)

profile.geography: Bengaluru showroom; demand spread over eight metros (45.9% of Indian sessions); Bengaluru 9.0%; 7.4% of sessions outside India
profile.persona: A phone shopper in a metro, browsing midday or 9-11PM, often a man buying festive jewellery for a woman (known audience only ~4% of impressions, directional).

Chat/WhatsApp widget (kwikchat)
Showroom Business Profile (directions, calls)

story60.problem: Google spend rose 143% in August; gross sales rose 21.8%. Profit could not be judged: margin and Meta spend were never supplied.
story60.leak: Checkout (cart to order 13.5%), returns (19.8% of gross reversed) and tracking (Google claimed 11.8 times the company's revenue).
story60.discovered: Reconciled Google exports to Shopify, billing and the client's 24-month workbook; per-campaign daily exports pinned the defect.
story60.did: Built brand Search, showroom PMax and cart remarketing; fixed the showroom goal; specced tracking repair, call tracking and three scale stages.
story60.changed: Showroom CPC Rs 38.60 to Rs 13.13; 1,356 showroom actions in August. Google spend +143.3%, orders +16.1%.
story60.evidence: Google Ads campaign, daily and search-term exports; Shopify 12-month export; billing summary; client MER workbook.
story60.lesson: Reconcile Google to Shopify weekly before scaling. Budget follows measured demand. Fix the cart before buying more traffic.
